en:
Miu's body showed severe trauma
and signs of a struggle.

Yeah, she looked like she suffered.
Very...hard to look at.

Right, and the Virtual World is
<CLT=cltSTRONG>connected to our five senses<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

If her body experienced pain, she must have
been in pain in the Virtual World as well.

Knowing that, I believe Maki is correct.
Miu was <CLT=cltSTRONG>strangled to death<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
...Yeah, definitely.

Strangling and poison are the only methods
that could make her look like she suffocated.

But we already removed the possibility of
poison, so it can only be strangulation.

Also...when a victim is poisoned, they
commonly grab their chest or mouth.

But Miu was holding her throat... It's obvious
she was trying to protect her windpipe.

Oooohhh! The assassin master gets 
reeeally chatty when it comes to corpses!

In that case, her exact cause of death 
is being <CLT=cltSTRONG>strangled in the Virtual World<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

But is strangulation even possible in the
Virtual World?

If the avatars were equally strong, it would
be difficult to strangle a resisting victim.

Yeah, if she was just as strong as them,
no way they coulda strangled her.
Then the culprit would need a <CLT=cltSTRONG>tool<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

There are tons of cases where a weaker person 
would strangle a stronger person with a rope.
Wow! You know a lot about killing! Nerd!

But was there even a rope in that world? 
I don't remember seeing one.

Then they musta used something
else as a rope.

<CLT=cltMIND>Something for a rope, hm?
I have an idea of what it might be.
<CLT=cltMIND>I found it during the investigation.

Uhhh-ooohhh! Got nothing?
Wasn't there something like a rope?
Shuichi, you really don't know?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Shuichi, something like a rope would be 
long and you could wind it around stuff!

Thanks, Captain Obvious, for that toootally
unnecessary hint!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
What was used to strangle Miu?

During the investigation, we found
<CLT=cltSTRONG>toilet paper<CLT=cltNORMAL> outside the mansion.

Is this...toilet paper?
What would toilet paper be doing here?

I'm guessing that the toilet paper
was used to strangle her.
What you mean, Shuichi?
Huh? What's wrong...?

What wrong!? Shuichi goofing off!
Not gentlemanly at all!
